configuration.autoRefresh.description: Whether to refresh quotes on a timer. When unchecked, quotes update only when you refresh manually.
configuration.refreshInterval.descriptio: Auto-refresh interval in milliseconds (e.g. 5000 means 5 seconds).
configuration.maskMode.description: Compact display mode: masks quote data in both the status bar and the sidebar watchlist as terse build-info text.
configuration.colorNeutral.description: Color-neutral mode: disables red/green gain-loss coloring and uses the editor's default foreground color.
configuration.colorScheme.description: Gain/loss color convention: greenUpRedDown (default) or redUpGreenDown.
configuration.statusBar.enabled.descript: Whether to rotate quotes in the status bar. When disabled, the status bar ticker is hidden entirely.
configuration.autoCollapseClosedGroups.d: Auto-collapse sidebar groups when their market is closed, and stop rotating their quotes in the status bar (the status bar hides silently when every market is closed).
configuration.proxyPort.description: Local proxy port (1-65535, default 10808). When unset, it adapts to the system HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY variables or common local proxy ports.
configuration.proxyUrl.description: Unified proxy address (HTTP / mixed proxies only). When unset, the system proxy environment variables are read, or a working local proxy is probed automatically.
configuration.fund.enabled.description: Enable fund and exchange-traded ETF quotes. When unchecked, funds are hidden from the watchlist.
configuration.fund.networkMode.descripti: Network access mode for funds: direct (default) or proxy.
configuration.fund.proxyUrl.description: Proxy address for the fund section.
configuration.fund.stopOnMarketClosed.de: Stop polling while the market is closed (when enabled, quotes are requested only during 9:15-11:30 and 13:00-15:05, the fund and A-share sessions).
configuration.fund.statusBar.description: Whether fund symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.aShare.enabled.description: Enable A-share market quotes. When unchecked, A-shares are hidden from the watchlist.
configuration.aShare.networkMode.descrip: Network access mode for A-shares: direct (default) or proxy.
configuration.aShare.proxyUrl.descriptio: Proxy address for the A-share section.
Stop polling while the market is closed (when enabled, quotes are requested only during 9:15-11:30 and 13:00-15:05).
configuration.aShare.statusBar.descripti: Whether A-share symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.hkStock.enabled.descriptio: Enable Hong Kong stock quotes. When unchecked, HK stocks are hidden from the watchlist.
configuration.hkStock.networkMode.descri: Network access mode for Hong Kong stocks: direct (default) or proxy.
configuration.hkStock.proxyUrl.descripti: Proxy address for the Hong Kong stock section.
configuration.hkStock.stopOnMarketClosed: Stop polling while the market is closed (when enabled, quotes are requested only during 9:30-12:00 and 13:00-16:10).
configuration.hkStock.statusBar.descript: Whether Hong Kong stock symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.usStock.enabled.descriptio: Enable US stock quotes. When unchecked, US stocks are hidden from the watchlist.
configuration.usStock.networkMode.descri: Network access mode for US stocks: direct (default) or proxy.
configuration.usStock.proxyUrl.descripti: Proxy address for the US stock section.
configuration.usStock.stopOnMarketClosed: Stop polling while the market is closed (when enabled, quotes are requested only on weekdays from 21:00 to 05:00 the next day).
configuration.usStock.statusBar.descript: Whether US stock symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.binance.networkMode.descri: Network access mode for Binance: proxy or direct.
configuration.binance.proxyUrl.descripti: Proxy address for the Binance section (auto-probes common local ports such as 10808, 10809, 7890, 7897 and 2080).
configuration.binance.statusBar.descript: Whether Binance symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.alpha.enabled.description: Enable Alpha on-chain token quotes (multi-chain DEX such as BSC, Solana and Base).
configuration.alpha.networkMode.descript: Network access mode for Alpha: proxy or direct.
configuration.alpha.proxyUrl.description: Proxy address for the Alpha section (auto-probes common local proxy client ports).
configuration.alpha.statusBar.descriptio: Whether Alpha symbols take part in the status bar carousel.
configuration.statusBar.holdingEnabled.d: Whether to show the independent holding P&L carousel item on the status bar (displays overall and per-symbol profit & loss, hidden in camo/boss key mode).
Interval in seconds for the status bar holding P&L carousel rotation (default: 3 seconds).
configuration.alerts.description: Price alert dictionary per symbol (breakout, breakdown and intraday volatility thresholds).
configuration.alertNotificationMode.desc: How price alerts are presented when a threshold is touched.
configuration.alertCooldownMinutes.descr: Mute cooldown in minutes for consecutive alerts on the same symbol.
